paragraphs: Tint A Window Developer Content Updates
Homepage and service pages | Final implementation instructions
Apply the exact changes below to the homepage and the 13 service pages. Nationwide coverage is confirmed. Location pages are excluded.
Hero: the small Christchurch eyebrow must be the page’s only H1. The large New Zealand headline must use a SPAN, replacing its existing H1 tag. Keep the small H1 clearly readable.
Other sections: keep the large section titles as H2. Their small eyebrows stay as P or SPAN elements. Use the same font, size and spacing for matching elements across pages.
Keep existing meta titles, URLs, buttons, images and other content. Scope shared component changes to the homepage and service pages. Do not edit location pages or the shared footer.

Service pages: in the film-options section, replace “Residential Services” with “Christchurch Residential Tinting”, “Commercial Services” with “Christchurch Commercial Tinting”, or “Compare your options” with “Christchurch Film Options”, whichever existing label that page uses.
Service pages: above the final H2 “Tell us what you would like to change.”, replace “Your next step” with “Christchurch Tinting Advice”. Apply this to all 13 service pages.
9 Heat and solar control window film

Each included page has one H1 in the small hero eyebrow, a large SPAN headline mentioning New Zealand, and the listed Christchurch section eyebrows. Existing H2 titles remain H2. Check desktop and mobile spacing after inserting the longer hero text.
